verdict.line: You lose fights you enter without E (Apprehend) ready, since Aatrox's Umbral Dash lets him disengage or extend his Darkin Blade swings onto you; you win once your hook lands and you stack Hemorrhage into a true-damage Guillotine before that dash comes off cooldown.

brief.thesis: Darius has no ranged tool and must land E (Apprehend) to force any trade, while Aatrox can poke with The Darkin Blade's multi-swing slams and bail or re-engage with Umbral Dash on a 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown. That's why the matchup sits at a measured 49.4% win rate over 4,257 games and reads as EVEN overall but defensive for Darius, with Aatrox holding the solo-kill edge whenever Darius commits without his hook up.

theirWindow.when: Infernal Chains lands, Umbral Dash ready
theirWindow.what: If you're caught in the Infernal Chains impact zone and don't clear it immediately, you take the drag-back hit again, and with Umbral Dash up Aatrox can dash in behind it to land extra Darkin Blade swings and a Deathbringer Stance auto. Walk out of the chain radius the instant it lands instead of trading through it.

yourWindow.when: E (Apprehend) connects, his dash is down
yourWindow.what: Once the hook lands with Umbral Dash on cooldown, Aatrox can't disengage. Chain W (Crippling Strike)'s slow into Q (Decimate) swings to stack Hemorrhage toward max stacks, then commit R (Noxian Guillotine) for the true-damage finish.

start.why: The measured pick (82% of games, 49.5% win rate over 4,208 games) gives the sustained-damage and lifesteal-adjacent healing needed to survive Aatrox's early poke before you can reliably land E.

boots.why: 80.3% pick at a 50% win rate — the attack-speed reduction blunts Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance autos and his basic attack pressure during extended trades.

core.why: The active haste and burst window close the gap Aatrox tries to keep with Umbral Dash, letting you follow his dash instead of losing him.
Move speed stacking helps you chase down a disengaging Aatrox and the bonus damage adds to your all-in once E connects.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror ramps AD and healing the longer you're locked in melee range, which matches Darius's all-or-nothing E-pull trade pattern against Aatrox's poke-and-dash kit (50.8% win rate, 23.9% pick). Master-tier players instead favor Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery) across 17,974 games — that suits a more mobile, hit-and-run Darius who leans on E's pull burst rather than grinding out extended stand-and-trade fights.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite holds the highest measured win rate for this matchup (50.5% over games with 32.9% pick), beating Flash+Ghost's higher-pick but lower-win 48.6% rate. Since OP.GG's own data gives Aatrox the solo-kill advantage, Ignite is the tool that closes out his all-ins before his E (Umbral Dash) heal or Deathbringer Stance sustain can offset the trade.

playing.title: Dodge the Q-E combo
playing.detail: Aatrox chains The Darkin Blade's swings with an Umbral Dash gap-close to extend his sword's reach onto you. Back off during his swing windup rather than trusting W (Crippling Strike)'s slow to save you — it only lands after your next attack connects, not before his dash does.

playing.title: Clear Infernal Chains zones
playing.detail: Infernal Chains only damages the first target hit, and only drags you back if you stay in the impact circle too long. Step out immediately instead of trading through it — a wasted cast puts his W on a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown you can punish.

playing.title: Pull only when his dash is down
playing.detail: Land E (Apprehend) when Umbral Dash is on cooldown so he can't dash away mid-pull. Once hooked, chain W into Q swings to stack Hemorrhage toward the 5-stack enrage before he can reset the engagement.

playing.title: Bank Hemorrhage stacks before R
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with Hemorrhage stacks on the target, so land Q and W bleeds first. Its cooldown refreshes on a kill, so finish low-health targets to carry that reset into the next skirmish.

playing.title: Track his Deathbringer Stance glow
playing.detail: Aatrox's passive empowers his next basic attack with bonus magic damage and healing on a periodic timer. Don't trade free autos with him at low health while that's up — it's a max-health-scaling snipe, not a normal hit.

playing.title: Trade only with E up
playing.detail: This lane is measured EVEN overall but defensive for Darius, with Aatrox favored in solo kills. Avoid extended auto-trades without E (Apprehend) ready — your wins come from forced all-ins, not passive farming exchanges.

playing.title: Force fights in your power window
playing.detail: Aatrox's R (World Ender) sits at a flat 80s cooldown from rank 3 onward, while your Hemorrhage-and-Guillotine snowball peaks from level 9-13. Look to force skirmishes in that window before his ultimate uptime and sustain catch back up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample figures above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the tells, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are this brief's own analysis layered on top of that data.
